brief: Draft the scene in Arabic: midday, Salma sorts her uncle's tools into what she will sell and what she will keep. The pen seller from next door looks in once, with one short exchange in guillemets; do not name him. Nader does not appear, and the manuscript stays shut on the bench. Close third person, past tense, under 220 words, with Arabic punctuation as the style sheet sets it. Keep every established fact. Invent nothing.
name: drafting-ar
